name: Table Flip Guy
look: A black and white rage comic drawing of a stick figure with a round head, one wide eye and an open screaming mouth, rising from a chair as he flips a table up into the air, with scribbled motion lines showing the force.
use: A reaction to extreme frustration. The caption names the last straw, and the figure flipping the table is the over-the-top response, often to a small annoyance that pushed someone over the edge.
examples: Game crashes right after the boss fight
last save was two hours ago
